jobs.description:
Company Activities

Our client is a leader in the travel bag, luggage, and accessories industry, known for combining style with cutting-edge design technology and a commitment to quality and durability. With over a century of heritage, they offer unparalleled products that meet the needs of travelers worldwide. Their brands are sold in over 100 countries, providing a diverse and inclusive work environment that values sustainability and innovation.

 

Jobomschrijving

Are you ready to take your career to the next level as a Mold Technician? Our client is seeking a skilled and motivated individual to join their team in Oudenaarde. As a Mold Technician, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation and maintenance of molds used in production.

Key Responsibilities:
	
• Independently assemble, disassemble, and maintain molds to ensure they are production-ready.	
• Repair hydraulic cylinders and create flexible hoses for hydraulic and gas applications.	
• Conduct fine mechanical work and apply simple sandblast structures.	
• Diagnose and propose technical improvements for defective molds.	
• Occasionally engage in turning, milling, and grinding tasks with training provided when necessary.

Profile Description

The ideal candidate for the Mold Technician role possesses:
	
• A Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics or an A2 in mechanics with a minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar position.	
• Experience in a production environment, especially in machining operations such as turning, grinding, and milling.	
• Strong technical insight and a passion for mechanics.	
• Basic knowledge of electricity.	
• Resilience under pressure and willingness to work in a two-shift system after the training period.	
• Good knowledge of English or Dutch.

About the Company:

Our client is a respected organization where quality, safety, and teamwork are core values. As a VCA**-certified company, they are committed to providing excellent service to their clients while fostering a growth-oriented and supportive environment for their employees. They are looking for individuals who share their passion for excellence and innovation.

Jobomschrijving

At our client’s company, quality and safety are at the heart of everything they do (VCA**-certified). Equally important, however, are their people. Due to their continued growth, they are looking for a motivated Industrial Electrician to make a real difference within their organization.

Your Role:
	
• Perform on-site interventions at the client’s location in case of issues.	
• Take responsibility for repairing reported problems at the client’s site.	
• Verify that the actions taken result in the optimal functioning of the equipment.	
• Ensure all work is delivered with a focus on safety, efficiency, quality, and timing.	
• Act as the main point of contact for the client on-site and provide internal reports to the project manager.	
• Collaborate effectively, whether working independently or as part of a team.

Profile Description: 

A technical education in an electrical field (or equivalent through experience).

Strong communication skills in Dutch or English.

A customer-friendly attitude: You prioritize client values and ensure commitments are met.

A flexible mindset: You adapt your approach as needed to achieve goals and handle changes effectively.

A valid driver’s license (Category B).

VCA and BA4/5 certifications are a plus, but not mandatory.

Since its founding in 1891, a culture of continuous innovation has made our client one of the world's leading manufacturers of heavy trucks and buses.

It's unique modular product system, developed over several decades, is one of our key success factors. It is an integral part of our flexible approach and lies at the heart of our business model.

Jobomschrijving

You will independently perform maintenance and repair work on our fleet of vehicles, including trucks and buses.
You'll work with a premium brand, and we’ll turn you into a true specialist in your field!

You’ll join a close team of experienced technicians, all working together toward one goal: providing fast and efficient service to our customers.

We are looking for a passionate mechanic with:
	
• Technical training (A2 or bachelor's degree) in automotive mechanics, electricity, or truck technology.	
•  	
• Knowledge of or experience with heavy vehicles such as trucks, agricultural vehicles, or forklifts.	
•  	
• The ability to work independently.	
•  	
• The motivation to continuously learn through our training programs.	
•  	
• You speak good Dutch or good English.

Our client is a well-established manufacturer of high-quality coffins, supplying products with a strong focus on craftsmanship, precision, and quality. To strengthen the production team in Drongen, we are looking for a motivated Machine Operator for the carpentry department.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator in the carpentry department, you will be responsible for various woodworking and production tasks, including:
	
• Operating planing, sawing, and gluing machines	
• Processing and assembling wooden components	
• Performing quality checks on finished products	
• Ensuring production targets and quality standards are met	
• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment

We are looking for someone who:
	
• Has experience operating production or woodworking machines	
• Has forklift experience or a valid forklift certificate (an advantage)	
• Is not afraid of physical work	
• Can communicate in Dutch, English, or French (Polish is also welcome)	
• Is reliable, motivated, and quality-conscious

Our client, company founded in 1948, is a Belgian family business specializing in exterior joinery. Their  Group covers a range of production units. The business unit Extrusion & Finishing extrudes, anodizes and enamels aluminum profiles. Our client specializes in custom-made exterior joinery in PVC, aluminum and wood. In addition to windows and doors, many additional products are also made, such as garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:

Without solid maintenance, there is no quality! As a maintenance technician, you will be responsible for monitoring wear and tear, tracking faults, analyzing causes, proposing solutions, and optimizing production processes. Your tasks will include:
	
• Routine inspections and preventive maintenance.	
• Risk analysis.	
• Working with top-quality machines and equipment.
By collaborating with external partners, you will have the opportunity to critically assess our client’s processes and advise management and production personnel on improving their machinery park. Working in their team also means continuous development, both individually and as part of a team

Candidate Profile:
	
• Preferred education: Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics, industrial engineering, or equivalent experience.	
• Open to all levels of experience - from junior to experienced specialists.	
• Commitment and practical approach to work.	
• Solid knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics.	
• Curiosity and passion for technology.	
• Attention to accuracy and safety in the workplace.	
• Flexibility and willingness to work in shifts.	
• Precision, attention to detail, and efficiency.	
• Teamwork and communication skills.	
• Openness to participating in the on-call system.	
• Basic/communicative knowledge of Dutch or English.

Our client specializes in bodywork and mechanical repairs for all car brands.

Jobomschrijving

Our client is looking for a skilled tinsmith to join their team. You will be responsible for the repair, maintenance, and installation of metal components. As a tinsmith you will play a key role in restoring and repairing vehicles or metal structures.

 

Your Responsibilities:
	
• Performing sheet metal work, including repairing damaged parts.	
• Installing and removing body panels, metal coverings, or structural components.	
• Metal processing (bending, straightening, cutting, welding).	
• Preparing surfaces for painting or further treatment.	
• Following safety regulations and maintaining a clean workspace.

Candidate Profile:
	
• Minimum 2 years of experience as a tinsmith.	
• Proficiency in using sheet metal tools (hammers, welding machines, grinders, etc.).	
• Knowledge of materials and techniques used in sheet metal work.	
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.	
• Attention to detail and precision in executing tasks.	
• Communicative knowledge of English or Dutch.

Company Activities:

Our client operates at the forefront of the aluminium window and door industry, offering bespoke solutions for both residential and commercial markets. Their subsidiary, specializing in high-end aluminium constructions, has earned a reputation for precision engineering and innovative designs. With a focus on sustainable practices and cutting-edge technology, they aim to set new benchmarks in the industry.

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a prominent leader in high-quality aluminium window and door solutions, is seeking a Technical Assembler to join their growing team near Eeklo. Specializing in both residential and commercial projects, they are known for their commitment to precision and innovation. If you have a keen eye for detail and experience in complex finishing processes, this opportunity is for you!

Key Responsibilities:
	
• Play a pivotal role in the assembly and finishing of new types of aluminium sliding frames, doors, and folding walls, ensuring the highest standards of precision and quality	
• Interpret technical drawings to align the finishing process with project requirements and client specifications	
• Report directly to the Production Manager, ensuring seamless communication and workflow.

Profile Description:
	
• A solid technical background	
• Affinity for complex products and a strong motivation to excel in a specialized role	
• Experience or interest in aluminium constructions	
• Your strengths include technical insight and a meticulous approach to work	
• Language Requirement: Proficiency in Dutch or English is mandatory.

Onze klant, een biotech bedrijf, gevestigd in Zwijnaarde, is een wereldwijd biotechnologiebedrijf dat de innovatieve CAR-T celtheraptie naar Gent brengt. Het bedrijf maakt hiermee dagdagelijks het verschil in het leven van vele patiënten die lijden aan kanker en andere levensbedreigende ziektes.
Ze zijn momenteel in een fase van sterke groei en zoeken gemotiveerde en toegewijde teamleden. 

Jobomschrijving

We’re looking for skilled individuals to join our mission of transforming medicine. This is more than just a job—it’s an opportunity to advance your career in a dynamic, purpose-driven environment. Whether you have a secondary education with hands-on experience or are a recent graduate with a bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related fields—and especially if you’ve worked in cleanrooms, pharmaceutical manufacturing, or chemical processing—we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for dedicated process operators to join our team at a leading biotechnology company. What can you expect in this exciting role?

Your journey begins with extensive training, where we immerse you in the world of aseptic (germ-free) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) operations, including the crucial procedures you need to master.

Afterward, you will join our dynamic and driven Operations team, which works together every day to fulfill our mission. Alongside your fellow operators and team leaders, you will perform aseptic and manual production processes according to strict, proven procedures.

Daily aseptic and manual production processes

Working in a cleanroom lab environment

Executing production steps in controlled environments (grade A/B/C/D) such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products.

Managing equipment: inspections and maintenance

Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials

Supporting transitions between production zones

Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

A strong sense of responsibility and passion to make a difference in the lives of patients.

Clear verbal and written communication skills with an attention to detail and the ability to follow procedures.

You thrive in fast-paced environments and are eager to learn and grow in advanced biomanufacturing.

You like structure and order, are very accurate and are willing to work in an aseptic environment with appropriate sterile clothing.

You have a relevant 'graduaat' or a bachelor’s degree. Alternatively, if you hold a secondary education diploma and have initial experience in a lab or cleanroom or hospital environment, pharmaceutical manufacturing, chemical processing, or similar regulated industries you are also eligible.

You are willing to work in a shift regime 4 days of working 4 days.

You speak very good English.

You’re excited to work with cutting-edge equipment and technologies

For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Kuurne.

Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.

You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. Thanks to your technical insight, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, production continues smoothly.

Your responsibilities:
 
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring production lines. 
• Performing quality checks and making adjustments where necessary. 
• Detecting technical malfunctions and independently resolving minor defects. 
• Carrying out machine changeovers, cleaning your equipment, and ensuring machines function correctly. 
• Recording production data and strictly following established procedures. 
• Assisting with preventive maintenance and actively contributing ideas for process improvements. 
• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.
Working hours are from Sunday evening to Friday morning in a fixed night shift from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM.
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a fixed night shift. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You are a team player and communicate effectively with colleagues. 
• You perform well under pressure in a fast-paced production environment. 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace during night hours. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

Our client is an innovative manufacturing company seeking an experienced engineering professional to strengthen its operations and accelerate continuous improvement projects.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead and execute manufacturing improvement and process optimization projects while managing multiple priorities.
• Identify production bottlenecks, implement practical solutions, and deliver measurable operational improvements.
• Drive automation initiatives by evaluating, improving, and supporting industrial control systems and automation solutions.
• Provide technical expertise to production, quality, maintenance, and commercial teams, including support for quality issues and new product feasibility assessments.
• Ensure projects are delivered on time, aligned with business objectives, and contribute to long-term operational excellence.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Electromechanical, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
• Proven experience in a manufacturing or production environment with expertise in project management, process optimization, automation, and continuous improvement.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a hands-on mindset and the ability to prioritize and deliver quick results.
• Good knowledge of SolidWorks and experience working with industrial machinery and manufacturing processes.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication skills; additional languages are considered an asset.

Founded in 1948, our client is a Belgian family-owned company specializing in exterior joinery. The group operates several production sites manufacturing aluminium, PVC and wooden windows, doors, garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems. The company is known for its modern production facilities, continuous innovation and long-term investment in employee development.

Jobomschrijving

If you are passionate about technology, eager to learn, and looking to build your career in a modern manufacturing environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Our client is looking for Junior Maintenance Technicians / Electromechanics who have a technical education and are motivated to develop their skills through comprehensive on-the-job training.

Without reliable maintenance, there is no quality! As a Maintenance Technician, you will help ensure the smooth operation of production by performing preventive maintenance, identifying technical issues, and supporting continuous improvements.

During approximately the first year, you will work in a two-shift system (early and late shifts) while completing your training. After your training period, you must be willing to work night shifts as part of the regular production schedule.

We are primarily looking for candidates who:
	
• Have a technical education in Electromechanics, or a related technical field (Bachelor's degree, Associate degree, technical secondary education, or equivalent).	
• Have a basic understanding of mechatronics, including fundamentals of PLC systems, sensors, actuators, electricity, mechanics and pneumatics.	
• Are motivated to learn and develop through practical training in the workplace.	
• Have a hands-on mentality and enjoy solving technical problems.	
• Work accurately and pay attention to safety.	
• Enjoy working in a team and communicate well with colleagues.	
• Have a communicative knowledge of Dutch or English.

Our client has over 100 years of expertise in cleaning and renting high-quality textiles. They provide their services to hospitals, healthcare institutions, and holiday parks in both the Netherlands and Belgium. Known for being accessible, nearby, and highly engaged, they are dedicated to delivering exceptional service and maintaining strong relationships with their clients. Joining their team means contributing to a legacy of excellence and reliability in the textile industry.

Jobomschrijving

Are you an experienced Driver with a passion for delivering excellent service? Our client is looking for dedicated Drivers to join their team in Oedelem (Oostkamp/Bruges). This is an exciting opportunity to work with a company that values reliability, professionalism, and teamwork.

Main Responsibilities:
	
• Operate vehicles (C and CE licenses) on fixed routes from Monday to Friday.	
• Drive 50% of the time and assist with loading/unloading 50% of the time.	
• Ensure timely and safe delivery of goods.	
• Handle physically demanding tasks, including moving heavy carts.	
• Maintain clear communication and adhere to schedules.

Profile Description

Our client is seeking Drivers who meet the following criteria:
	
• Valid C or CE driving license, medical clearance, and Code 95 certification.	
• Excellent command of Dutch, French, or English.	
• Physically fit and capable of handling heavy loads.	
• Reliable, with a strong work ethic and minimal absenteeism.	
• Able to provide good references.

Our client is a well-established company operating in all segments of passenger transport, including public transport, school and company transport, and coach tourism services. With multiple locations across Belgium and Luxembourg, they are looking for a skilled Bus Mechanic to strengthen their garage team in Affligem or Lede.

Jobomschrijving

 

Your Responsibilities
	
• Independently perform both simple and complex mechanical and electrical repairs and installations on buses.	
• Carry out preventive maintenance and diagnostics.	
• Report all maintenance and repair work accurately using the company's garage application.	
• Take the lead when necessary and provide support and guidance to fellow technicians.	
• Participate in technical training courses provided by various bus manufacturers.

You have a solid technical background in vehicle mechanics.

You have knowledge of vehicle electronics and can read electrical diagrams.

You are passionate about technology and work accurately, safely, and independently.

You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) diploma in Automotive Technology or have equivalent experience.

You are proactive, able to identify technical issues, and find effective solutions.

You communicate well in English, Dutch, or French.

Experience with the maintenance of suspension systems, brakes, filters, and general vehicle servicing is required.

Experience working on trucks is an advantage; experience with buses is even better.

A Category B driving licence is considered an asset, as occasional roadside assistance may be required.

Company Activities:

Our client is part of the circular economy based on wood fibers. In Belgium, the company has three units employing around 600 employees. The plant in Langerbrugge (Ghent) produces high-quality newspaper and magazine paper from 100% recycled paper. Thanks to two biomass power plants that provide the necessary process steam and three wind turbines, the company is one of the most sustainable enterprises in North Sea Port. Safety is the top priority, and thanks to intensive training programs, employees develop both professionally and personal

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading global producer of renewable solutions for paper, packaging, pulp, and wood constructions, is looking for an Electrical Maintenance Technician. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining the electrical network up to a voltage level of 150 kV.

Your daily tasks will include:
	
• Managing the lighting network.	
• Maintaining fire detection systems.	
• Operating frequency converters (ABB, Siemens, Danfoss).	
• Controlling various types of power switches (Siemens, ABB).

The ideal candidate should:
	
• Hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.	
• Have several years of experience in a similar role in an industrial production environment.	
• Be passionate about electricity and keep up-to-date with the latest trends in the field.	
• Think pragmatically and solve problems.	
• Plan and organize work effectively, with a focus on achieving results.	
• Communicate in English or Dutch at a good level.

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the teams. Your tasks will include:
	
• Maintenance and monitoring of electrical systems, such as switchboards, electrical installations, and emergency repairs;	
• Supervision of gas installations, ensuring safety and proper functioning of these systems;	
• Maintenance of HVAC systems (Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning), ensuring adequate temperature and air quality in buildings;	
• Diagnostics and repair of heating systems.

Profile:
	
• You have completed technical training and have relevant experience 	
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas	
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team	
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics	
• You can work in a 6-shift system and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge	
• You speak good English.

About the company:

Our client, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company introducing innovative CAR-T cell therapy. Their team is making a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a strong growth phase and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading biotechnology company, is looking for individuals interested in joining their team as a Support Operator/Laboratory Disinfection Specialist.

Before you join their professional team, you will receive thorough training in aseptic (germ-free) work, GMP, and related procedures. As a support operator, you will be responsible for maintaining the assigned areas and production zones in the laboratory in spotless condition. With the utmost precision, you will ensure the maintenance of equipment used, and the cleanliness and disinfection of materials. You will handle cleaning agents and materials safely and correctly. The laboratory works with biological products in a strictly controlled environment where your attention to detail can impact human lives.

 

Step into the world of biotechnology and become part of a dynamic team!

Profile:

• Cleanliness and order are very important to you.

• Experience in a sterile environment is a plus.

• You are enthusiastic about teamwork and can work well both independently and in a group.

• You are highly proficient in English.

• You have at least basic knowledge of MS Office (as a large part of the job involves recording, reporting, and online training).

• Wearing a sterile suit and strictly following procedures is no problem for you.
